arguments.subject: Launch plan: decisions and owners
arguments.body:
Hi team,

Decisions: the launch moves to 15 December; the closed beta is limited to 50 users; payments move to version 2.

Owners: Karim - SSO login fix by 20 November. Sara - onboarding designs by 25 November. Omar - closed beta test plan by 1 December. Mona - beta invites on 5 December.

Thanks,
Mona

decisions.text: الـ launch هيكون يوم 15 ديسمبر بدل 1 ديسمبر
نعمل closed beta لـ 50 مستخدم بس

action_items.text: يجهز test plan للـ closed beta
تبعت الـ beta invites للـ 50 مستخدم

final.ar: كتبتلك draft للإيميل فيه القرارات ومين مسؤول عن إيه. ماتبعتش حاجة: راجعه ووافق عليه لو تمام.
final.en: I drafted an email with the decisions and the owners. Nothing was sent: review it and approve it if it looks right.
